delete.summary: Deletes an encoded version (or cancels a queued one). Devices can request it again.

post.summary: Adds a library and starts its first scan.

delete.summary: Removes a library from BatVision (files on disk are never touched).

get.summary: Searches TMDB, to pick the right match for a misidentified item.

post.summary: Pins a movie to a TMDB id. Later scans never override a manual identification.
Pins a series to a TMDB id and refetches its seasons and episodes.
Gives a locked-out user a temporary password and signs out their devices.

delete.summary: Removes a user's second factor: for a lost phone with no recovery code left.

post.summary: Creates an account from an invitation link and signs the device in.
Approves the code shown on another device, signing it in as the caller.

This device drops an item, downloaded or not (D74): removes whatever asks for it,
and its pending request. The device deletes its copy (or partial file) itself.
The device finished downloading: the server can drop its cache copy.

get.summary: An encoded file (video or subtitle), with Range support to resume downloads.

post.summary: What this device should have on disk. Call on start, when back online, periodically.
Asks the server to prepare an expected item (encoding starts only now).

get.summary: Liveness check used by Docker and the reverse proxy.
A file of an HLS session. Waits for ffmpeg to produce it.
TMDB image (poster, backdrop, still), cached on disk. Public, so it works in `` tags; only images referenced by the library are served.

delete.summary: Signs a device out. Its token stops working immediately.

put.summary: Changes the password and signs out every other device.

post.summary: Disables 2FA. Not allowed for administrators, for whom it is mandatory.
Replaces all recovery codes (for example after using several of them).
Starts 2FA enrollment. 2FA becomes active only after `/api/me/totp/enable`.

oneOf.description: Sort direction (D75). Omitted: the sort's natural one (`asc` for title, else `desc`).

post.summary: Stops an HLS session (leaving the player). Sessions also stop on their own when idle.

get.summary:
The timeline thumbnails of a movie or episode. Asking for them makes them (and those
of the next episode) when missing.

put.summary: Marks a movie, an episode, or every episode of a season or series as (un)watched.

post.summary: Reports the playback position (every few seconds, on pause and on exit).
Progress made offline, uploaded in one go. The most recent watch wins.

get.summary: Finds movies and series whose title contains `q` (in any fetched language).

oneOf.description: Sort direction (D75). Omitted: the sort's natural one (`asc` for title, else `desc`).

post.summary: Creates the first administrator. They must then enable 2FA before using admin features.

get.summary: The original file, with HTTP Range support (seeking).
A subtitle as WebVTT. Extraction is cached; the time shift is applied per request.
Server version and detected ffmpeg capabilities (admins only).

put.summary:
Adds a series: its next unwatched episodes download on devices with automatic
downloads, in the series' audio language (D73).

language.description: ISO 639-2 code as tagged in the file (`fre`, `eng`…), if any.

removed.description:
What no longer asks for the item: a manual download, a subscription of this
device, a watchlist entry (every device). Empty if nothing did.

Capabilities.description: What a client says it can play.

hdr.description: Can display HDR as is. Otherwise HDR video is tone-mapped to SDR.

hls_subtitles.description:
Shows subtitles of an HLS stream only from inside the stream (Apple's players):
HLS streams then come with a master playlist that lists the subtitle (D88).

path.description: Folder relative to the media root, e.g. `Films`.

DeviceInfo.description: What a client says about itself when signing in.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the device list ("Pixel 9", "Firefox – Mac").

charging_only.description: Download only while the device charges (D69).

mobile_cap_bytes.description: Monthly mobile data cap, counted by the device.

mobile_data.description: What may download over mobile data (D68).

quota_bytes.description: Space downloads may use on the device; `None` = no limit.

storage.description: Android: app storage or SD card.

items.description: In priority order: keep the longest prefix that fits the quota, delete the rest.

devices.description: The user's devices able to download (apps, not browsers).

waiting_devices.description: Devices that asked and haven't confirmed the download yet.

ErrorBody.description:
Error body returned by every endpoint. `code` is stable and meant for clients;
`message` is for humans and logs.

watched.description: Watched: kept until `keep_until`, and the first to go when space runs out.

gpu_filters.description: Decoding, scaling and HDR tone mapping on the NVIDIA GPU work.

version.description: First line of `ffmpeg -version`, or `None` if ffmpeg could not be run.

working_encoders.description: Encoders that completed a test encode.

external_subtitles.description: Subtitle files next to the video.

oneOf.description: `None` until the file has been analyzed (or if analysis failed).
Big banner at the top: what's in progress, else what's next, else the latest movie.

top_rated_movies.description: Best TMDB ratings with enough votes to mean something (D76).

HomeItem.description: A movie or an episode, ready to show as a card.

image_path.description: Wide image: movie backdrop, episode still (or series backdrop).

title.description: Movie title, or series title for an episode.

token.description: Shown only once. The client builds the invitation link from it.

oneOf.description: Password accepted; send a TOTP or recovery code to `/api/auth/login/totp`.

position_ms.description: The caller's resume position (0 if not started or already watched).

OfflineProgress.description: One progress record made offline, uploaded when the device is back online.

at.description: When it happened on the device, Unix seconds.

title.description: Movie title, or series title for an episode.

av1.description: The device decodes AV1 in hardware (then lighter versions use AV1).

qualities.description: What each level gives for this file, best first.

quality.description: The quality level of this stream.

session_id.description: HLS session, to stop it when leaving the player.

start_ms.description: HLS: media time at which the stream starts (its time 0). Direct: where to seek.

subtitle_url.description: WebVTT for the selected text subtitle, timed for this stream.

url.description: Direct: the file. Otherwise an HLS playlist (play with hls.js).

audio_index.description: Audio stream index chosen by the user. Omitted: automatic choice.

remember.description: The user changed tracks: remember the choice for the rest of the series.

start_ms.description: Where to start, in ms. Omitted: the resume position.

audio_language.description: ISO 639-2 code (`fre`, `eng`…). `None`: the file's default track.

watchlist_episodes.description: Unwatched episodes kept for each watchlist series, 1 to 10 (D73).

played.description: True once watched past 90 %: the client can offer the next episode.

Quality.description:
Picture quality asked by the player (D60). Below `Max`, a source heavier than
the level is transcoded down to it.

QualityOption.description:
What each quality level gives for this file and client, for the player's menu
and its automatic choice.

original.description: The original video is sent as is (direct play or remux).

oneOf.description: Not approved yet: poll again in a few seconds.

code.description: Show this on screen; the user types it on a signed-in device.

Rating.description: An average rating from one source. Ratings with fewer than 5 votes are left out.

codes.description: Shown only once. Each code can be used once instead of a TOTP code.

metadata_skipped.description: Why metadata was skipped, if it was (no TMDB token…).

newly_missing.description: Items not found anymore (hidden until their files come back).

in_watchlist.description: In the caller's watchlist: its next episodes download automatically (D73).

oneOf.description: Episode the play button starts: the one in progress, else the next unwatched.

unplayed_count.description: Episodes the caller hasn't watched yet.

Session.description: Returned when a device is signed in. The token is shown only once.

token.description:
Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Absent for web clients: their token
is set as an HttpOnly cookie, out of reach of page scripts.

setup_token.description: Printed in the server logs at startup while no account exists.

needed.description: True while no account exists: the first admin must be created with the setup token.

count.description: rolling: number of unwatched episodes to keep (1 to 20).

text.description: Image subtitles are burned into the video (triggers a transcode).
Text subtitles can be converted for the client; image ones must be burned in.

oneOf.description: `None` while the startup probe is still running.

password.description: Shown once: give it to the user, who then chooses their own.

code.description: Current code from the authenticator app, proving it was set up correctly.
6-digit code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code.

otpauth_url.description: `otpauth://` URL, to display as a QR code.

TrackKind.description: What a track is for, used to carry a track choice from one episode to the next.

TrickplayInfo.description:
Timeline thumbnails (D99): `count` pictures of `width` × `height`, one every
`interval_ms`, laid out `columns` × `rows` per sheet, left to right then top to bottom.
Thumbnail `n` (at `n × interval_ms`) is in sheet `n / (columns × rows)`.

sheets.description: Signed URLs of the sheets (JPEG), in order. Empty unless `ready`.

hdr.description: HDR10/HLG/Dolby Vision, detected from the transfer characteristics.

audio_language.description: ISO 639-2 audio language to download; omitted = the preferred one.
Movies: the audio language chosen when adding. Series: `None` (D73).

played.description: Movie watched, or every episode of the series watched.
